build.nextStep: Confirm top module and board profile, then run one clean synth pass.
build.why: A correct top module and profile prevent false downstream failures.
mistakes: Top module name does not match expected entry module.
Board profile is left on the default from a different lab.
Build warnings are ignored before simulation.

simulate.nextStep: Run simulation and capture one waveform/probe artifact before moving on.
simulate.why: Simulation gives deterministic evidence before hardware variability enters.
mistakes: Skipping probes and only checking compile output.
Not capturing at least one expected signal transition.
Moving to hardware without sim evidence.

hardware.nextStep: Detect board and capture one observable run if hardware is required.
hardware.why: Hardware evidence validates the full deployment path.
mistakes: Assuming board detection succeeded without checking status.
Programming without confirming probe/capture setup.
Skipping hardware notes for submission evidence.

submit.nextStep: Review gate status and generate the bundle only when blockers are clear.
submit.why: Submission gates prevent avoidable grading and reproducibility failures.
mistakes: Submitting while blockers are still present.
Missing required evidence files.
Ignoring warnings that affect reproducibility.

build.nextStep: Confirm your gate module ports align with the lab starter and rebuild.
build.why: Port alignment errors cause cascading simulation mismatches.
mistakes: Input/output direction or widths are mismatched.
Top module is not set to the lab target.
Rebuild step skipped after HDL edits.

simulate.nextStep: Run the starter vectors and verify each expected output transition.
simulate.why: Vector-level checks prove combinational correctness before hardware.
mistakes: Only checking one input combination.
Misreading active-high vs active-low behavior.
Not comparing expected and observed outputs.

hardware.nextStep: Program the board and confirm at least one matching I/O observation.
hardware.why: Hardware confirmation validates wiring and timing assumptions.
mistakes: Bitstream programmed for the wrong top module.
Switch/button polarity interpreted incorrectly.
No captured hardware observation in notes.

submit.nextStep: Clear blockers and generate a submission bundle with evidence attached.
submit.why: Complete evidence accelerates TA verification and reduces rework.
mistakes: Submitting with missing waveform or gate evidence.
Ignoring a block-level gate message.
Exporting before final preflight check.
